field: Registered Nursing, Nursing Administration, Nursing Research and Clinical Nursing

programs.evidence: Mercy University runs a fully online RN to B.S. degree completion track for nurses who already hold a license, so many of its graduates were already working nurses before they graduated.
Pacific College's nursing bachelor's is described as an RN-to-BSN completion program taught mostly online, not a route to first licensure, so its students are already licensed working nurses.

Sonoma State's Post-Licensure BSN requires a current California RN license for upper-division credit and draws from partner community college ADN programs, so many graduates are already RNs in the high-paying Bay Area.
Registered nurse pay in Puerto Rico is the lowest among the states, D.C. and Puerto Rico, far below the mainland, and that alone explains low earnings for its nursing graduates.
